content: Iyo7aabey Dawite Walassida Walasse
Iyo7aabes, «Kawo Dawiti ba naa Abeseloome gishshas yeekkishenne kayottishe dees» geetetti yootettides.
Kawozi, «Ba naaza gishshas kayottees» gizayssa he gallas olanchchati siyida gishshas he gallassa xoonoy kumeththa olanchchata matan ceecen laametti pe7ides.
He gallas olappe yeellatishe katama geliza asa mala dereykka shaaphettishe katama gelides.
Kawozi ba ayfeso kammi woththidi, «Ta naa Abeseloome woo! Ta naa Abeseloome woo» gishe zilalides.
Hessafe guye Iyo7aabey kawozaso gelidi, «Ne shemppo, ne attuma nayta shemppo, ne macca nayta shemppo, ne machchetanne ne laggeththota shemppo ashshida asata hach ne yeellachchadasa.

Nena ixxizayta ne dosaasa; qasse nena dosizayta ixxaasa; ne ola gadawatinne istta wottadarati nees aykkoka gidonttayssa hekko hach ne qonccisadasa; hach Abeseloomey shemppora paxa diin nu ubbay wuridaakko ne ufayettanayssa ta be7adis.

Ha7i dendada kare keza asaa minththeththa; ne kezontta ixxiko ha omarsayn issi asikka nenara gidonttayssa ta GODAA sunththan caaqqays; hessi nees naateteththafe doommiin hayssa gakkanaas ne bolla gakkida iita yo7ota ubbaafe aadho meto ne bolla gaththana» gides.

Hessa gishshas kawozi penge lanqen uttiin derezas, «Hekko kawozi penge lanqen uttides» geetetti yootettiin derezi ubbay kawozaakko yides. Yerusalaame Baanaas Dawite Denth He wode kumeth Isra7eele asay baso baso baqatides.

Kumeththa Isra7eele qommoti, derezikka ba garsan issoy issaara marshettishe, «Kawozi nuna nu morkketa kusheppe kessi ekkides; Filisxeemeta kusheppeka nuna ashshiday iza; ha7i gidikko Abeseloome gaason dereppe baqati bides.
Izi nuna haarana mala nu tiyda Abeseloomey gidikko olan hayqqides. Histtiin intte kawoza simo gishshas ays co7u geetii?» gides.

Kawo Dawiti qeese Saadooqessinne Abiyaataares kiita yeddishe, «Yuhuda cimatas, ‹Kumeththa Isra7eelen haasayettiza yo7o ubbay kawozi dizason izas gakkida gishshas kawoza kawoteththa keeth zaaranaas intte waanidi wurseththa as gideetii?
Intte ta meqeththata, ta ashotanne ta ishata; histtiin intte kawoza zaaranaas waanidi wurseththa as gideetii?› giite.

«Qasse Amasi, ‹Nenikka ta meqeththinne ta asho gidikkii? Hannife doommidi ne de7o wurseth gakkanaas Iyo7aabe qoodhe ta olanchchata azazizaade ooththontta aggiko Xoossi ta bolla iita miish ooththo; hessafekka aadhdhiza iita miish ta bolla eho› gides» giidi yootite.
Izikka Yuhuda asaa ubbaa wozina issi asa wozina mala histti di7ides; isttika izas, «Neni ne asaa ubbaara simma» giidi kiita yeddida.
Kawozi hessafe guye simmidi Yordaanoose gakkanaas yides. He wode Yuhuda asay kawoza ekkidi Yordaanoose pinththanaas Gelgela gakkanaas bides.
Bahirime dere as Geera naa Biniyaame qommo Shim7ey kawo Dawite mokkanaas Yuhuda asaara issife eeson wodhdhides.
Issi shii Biniyaame qommoti, hessaththoka Sa7ooleso oosanchcha Xiibbas 15 attuma naytinne 20 aylleti izara issife deettes. Hessafe guye kawozi dizaso Yordaanoose eeson wodhdhida.
Kawozaso asaa ehanaassinne izi koyida ubbaa ooththanaas istti zokkora pinnida. Dawiti Shim7e Maarida Maaro Geera naa Shim7ey Yordaanoose pinnides; kawoza sinththan gufannidi,
«Ta godawu ta nena qohidayssa qoodoppa; ta godaa kawo ne Yerusalaameppe kezida gallas ta ooththida mooroza maara; ne wozinan woththofa.
Tani ne oosanchchay ooththida nagara eriza gishshas hach ta godaa kawoza mokkanaas Yooseefe keeththa asaa ubbaafe koyrotta yadis» gides.
Hessafe guye Xuriya naa Abisayey, «Shim7ey GODAAN tiyettidaade izi cayida gishshas izas hayqoy bessennee?» gides.

Dawitikka, «Intteno Xuriya naytoo; inttenara tana aazi gaththizee? Intte hach taas morkke gidideta! Ay asikka hach Isra7eeleppe hayqqana bessizee? Hessi ta Isra7eele bolla kawotidayssa ta erida gallas gidennee?» gides.
Hessa gishshas kawozi Shim7e, «Neni hayqqaka» gides; hessa kawozi caaqon minththides.
Dawiti Memfeboste Maarida Maaro

Sa7oole naa Memfebostey kawoza mokkanaas duge wodhdhides; kawozi beti boosofe doommidi simmi yida gallas gakkanaas ba tohos bessiza miish ooththibeenna; ba buuchcheka meedettibeenna; ba may7oka meeccibeenna.
Izi kawoza mokkanaas Yerusalaameppe yiin kawozi iza, «Memfeboste, ne tanara aazas bontta aggadii?» gi oychchides.

Izikka zaaridi, «Ta godaa kawoo! Ta ne oosanchchay toho sila gidida gishshas, ‹Tani kawozara baana mala ta harey taas kooretto; ta iza bolla utta baana› gadis; gido attiin ta oosanchcha Xiibbay tana baleththides.
Ta godaa kawo sinththan tana ne oosanchchaza sunth moorides; ayde gidiinkka ta goday kawoy neni Xoossa kiitanchcha mala gidida gishshas nena lo7ida ubbaa ooththa.
Ta aawa keeththas ubbaas hayqoy bessishin neni gidikko tana ne oosanchchaza ne maaddafe mizaytara issife utisadasa; hayssafe haray taas hano gaada kawoza oychchanaas ta oonee?» gides.
Kawozikka, «Ne ays yo7o darsay? Neninne Xiibbay iza gadaa ubbaa intte gishetti ekkana mala ta azazadis» gides.
Memfebostey kawoza, «Ta godaa kawoo! Izi hashshu lo7on simmides; ubbaaka izi ekko» gides.
Dawiti Barziles Ooththida Kiyateth
Hessaththoka Gala7aade dere as Barziley Erogilime woradappe kawoza moyzanaas izara issife Yordaanoose pinnides.
He wode Barziley wode sugida 80 layththa cima; izi keehi dure gidida gishshas kawozi Mahanaymen dishin izas maana miish ehides.
Kawozi Barzile, «Tanara pinnada Yerusalaamen issife da; ta nena heemmana» gides.
Barziley gidikko kawozas, «Tani kawozara Yerusalaamen ay keena layth daanaas boo?

Tani ha7i 80 layththa cima; Histtiin tani iitanne kiya shaakka erana dandayanee? Hayssafe guye ne aylley mizayssanne uyizayssa mal7o shaakki eranee? Attuma nayta cenggurssinne macca nayta cenggurs ha7i ta siyana dandayanee? Histtiin ne aylley ta godaa kawozas ays bollara hara tooho gidanee?
Ne aylley kawozara pinnidi guuththa oge baana; kawoy hessa kushe taas zaarandee?

Ta diza katamaan hayqqada ta aawaanne ta aayey duufo achchan ta moogettana mala ne aylleza ne moyzikko izi simmo; gido attiin ne aylle Keme7aamey ta godaa kawozara pinno; histtiko nena lo7ida miish ne izas ooththa» gides.
Kawozikka, «Keme7aamey tanara pinnana; nena ufayssiza miish ubbaa ta izas ooththana; ne taappe koyza ay miishshika ta nees ooththana» gides.
Hessa gishshas derezi ubbay Yordaanoose pinnides; hessafe guye kawozi pinnides. Kawozi Barzile yeeri ekkidi anjjides; Barzileykka baso simmi bides.
Dawite Gishshas Deraa Marsheteth
Kawozi Gelgela bishin Keme7aamey izara issife bides; Yuhuda olanchchati ubbaynne Isra7eele olanchchatappe baggay kawoza azhabidi pinththida.
Heerakka Isra7eele asay ubbay kawozaakko yiidi, «Nu ishati Yuhuda asati kawoza garsara banttarkka izanne izaso asata, iza kaallizaytara Yordaanoose ays pinththidoo?» gida.

Yuhuda asay ubbay Isra7eele asaas, «Nu hayssa ooththiday kawozi nuus mata dabbo gidida gishshassa; histtiin hayssi inttena hanqeththizee? Nuni kawoppe ekki mida miishshi dizee? Nuni ay miish ekkidonii?» gida.

Hessafe guye Isra7eele asay Yuhuda asaas, «Nuna kawozappe tammu kushey gakkees; hessafe bollarakka inttefe nuus aadhdhiza maatay dees; histtiin intte nuna aazas kadhidetii? Nu kawozi simmana mala koyro oychchiday nuna gidokkonii?» gida. Gido attiin Yuhuda asay immida zaaroy Isra7eele asay immida zaaroppe keehi mino.
